display.purpose: The stamped verdict score and every report figure — serif with tabular figures.

headline.purpose: The login masthead — display type for the one page that argues.

title.purpose: Plate titles and the topbar wordmark.

body.purpose: UI prose and controls; the workhorse sans.

label.purpose: Field labels and transcript attributions — uppercase, tracked, faint.

evidence.purpose: SHAs, file:line citations, counts ledgers, tool names — quoted from the machine.

shadows.name: plate-drop
shadows.purpose: The login plate's single soft drop — the only drop shadow at rest (light rgba(29, 26, 22, 0.08), dark rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)).

shadows.name: stamp-seal
shadows.purpose: The verdict stamp's tone-locked inner rule — a printed seal, not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: row-lift
shadows.purpose: The hover shadow under an actionable row, paired with a 1px rise (translate 0 -1px). Repositories, analyses and transcript suggestions only; static exhibits, findings rows and plan steps never lift.

texture.name: paper-grain
texture.value: fixed SVG feTurbulence noise (fractalNoise, saturate 0), --grain-opacity 0.03 light / 0.055 dark
texture.purpose: The sheet's tooth: a monochrome grain over every page, applied via the .paper utility on the shell and login. Fixed and static — texture, not motion.

texture.name: ink-vignette
texture.value: radial-gradient(130% 100% at 50% 0%, transparent 58%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent) 100%)
texture.purpose: A 4% ink fall-off at the page's edges, fixed with the grain in the same paper layer. Monochrome, static, never tinted.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The system's one curve (EASE in lib/motion.ts, --ease-out in CSS): values land, nothing bounces. Every transition, entrance and count.

motion.name: score-count
motion.purpose: The verdict numeral counts to its value once (ScoreHero).

motion.name: stamp-land
motion.purpose: The verdict stamp lands (opacity/scale 1.12 to 1) as the count finishes; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: meter-settle
motion.value: 520ms fill; per-pillar delay 200ms + 60ms x index, triggered on first view
motion.purpose: Pillar meter fills settle onto their tick rules in sequence, once.

motion.name: meter-figure
motion.purpose: The meter's serif figure counts up with its bar — one gesture.

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Hover, colour, and border transitions on controls and rows.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: An ink press answers immediately (.press and the base button).

motion.name: sheen-sweep
motion.purpose: A monochrome canvas-toned sweep across filled controls.

motion.name: row-lift
motion.purpose: The cursor's answer on actionable rows only — never static exhibits, findings rows or plan steps.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Sections arrive on their own scroll (Reveal); travel drops under reduced motion.

motion.name: row-enter
motion.purpose: Ledger rows and exhibits arrive as a list, tail capped.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Sibling stagger is capped so long lists arrive as one quiet block.

motion.name: indicator-slide
motion.purpose: Rail, mobile strip and analysis-tab ink rules slide between destinations; the static rule is the no-motion fallback.

motion.name: theme-flip
motion.value: 320ms colour transition, applied for the switch only (class removed after 420ms)
motion.purpose: One continuous colour inversion, not a repaint.

motion.name: masthead-rule
motion.purpose: The topbar's 1px rule is drawn on arrival; full width instantly under reduced motion.

motion.name: caret
motion.purpose: The streaming caret in the agent transcript, only while an answer arrives.

motion.name: sparkline-draw
motion.value: 900ms pathLength; head dot 200ms at a 700ms delay
motion.purpose: The trend line draws itself once and is aria-hidden decoration; duration 0 under reduced motion.

motion.name: login-choreography
motion.value: masked lines 650ms (delays 0 / 0.09s); plate 550ms at 0.16s; paragraph 500ms at 0.24s; sample exhibit 500ms at 0.32s; exhibit lines 400ms at 0.5s / 0.6s
motion.purpose: The login masthead's staged arrival: lines out of their masks, everything else behind them.

motion.name: expand-height
motion.purpose: Expanding surfaces open in place: the approval form, finding snippets, plan steps.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Loading skeleton sweep; stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: In-flight dots while work is actually running; stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: float
motion.purpose: The empty-state mark's gentle drift; stopped under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion=user drops transform/scale/layout; CSS caps durations at 140ms and iterations at 1, stops loops, opacity-only entrance, lift rise removed
motion.purpose: Fewer and gentler, not none: feedback that confirms an action stays legible; the sparkline renders finished (duration 0).

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Denser rows open up: ledger counts, the login name, and the log-out label appear.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The rail appears beside the content; the mobile tab strip and the login masthead retire.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ink-filled primary action — analyze, sign in, approve; carries the sheen and the press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--canvas); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 38%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas) 26%, transparent) 50%, transparent 62%); transform: translateX(-130%); transition: transform 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 88%, var(--canvas)); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 88%, var(--canvas)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: translateX(130%); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--canvas); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The hairline button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 80ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--muted); } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Borderless button for chrome actions such as log out.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-btn-ghost:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The one text field: 34px, one hairline, ruled-not-glowing focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A print ticket, not a pill — tonal variants carry the status vocabulary (shown: hypothesis).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.6; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip--hypo { color: var(--hypo); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--hypo) 40%, transparent); background: var(--hypo-soft); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: A dossier page: flat paper, one hairline, 24px padding, serif figure.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 24px; } .ds-figure { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink); } .ds-figure-unit { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--faint); } .ds-label { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); }

components.name: Hoverable Row Card
components.description: An actionable ledger row that recesses to Recessed Paper and lifts 1px under the cursor — repositories and analyses only.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 14px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), translate 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--line-strong); translate: 0 -1px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px var(--shadow); } .ds-card-title { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card-meta { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--faint); }

components.name: Rail Nav Item
components.description: A rail section-index item; the active item takes Recessed Paper and a 1px ink left rule.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-nav--active { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-nav--active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; width: 1px; background: var(--ink); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verdict Stamp
components.description: The verdict seal: glyph + word + hue, with a tone-locked currentColor double rule.
components.html: healthy
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 8px; color: var(--ok); border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--surface), inset 0 0 0 2px currentColor; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.7; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tick-Rule Meter
components.description: The one bar primitive; the value lands on a tick lattice, and unmeasured states hatch instead of filling.
components.html: 72
components.css: .ds-meter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-meter-track { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 3px; min-width: 0; background: var(--surface-2); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line) 0 1px, transparent 1px 10%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-meter-fill { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; background: var(--pillar-security); } .ds-meter-value { min-width: 32px; text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
Every screen in Retract is a numbered inspection dossier: exhibits with verdicts and cited evidence. The interface refuses the dashboard-of-identical-cards default — the report is the interface, and reading it is the product. Scores arrive as stamped verdicts, pillars as a numbered schedule, findings as cited exhibits, and approvals as signatures on the record.

The material world is warm paper and ink. One monochrome ladder carries the light theme (paper under a desk lamp) and the dark theme (the same dossier at night, chalk ink on warm near-black); the two are co-equal. Structure is drawn with hairline rules, not shadows; display numerals are set in a screen serif with tabular figures; evidence — SHAs, file:line, tool names, counts — is set in Geist Mono so it reads as quoted from the machine. Hue is held in reserve and appears only where it is evidence: severity, run status, verification, hypotheses — and never without its word and its glyph.

The reading posture is calm density: quiet chrome, short declaratives, one accent's worth of expression. Primary actions are filled with ink itself, and every page sits on the same sheet: a fixed monochrome grain and a 4% ink vignette over the whole surface. Motion is one settling curve, and it carries feedback and continuity, not decoration — verdicts stamp once, indicators slide between destinations, rows answer the cursor, and the rest of the print stays still.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper-and-ink monochrome ladder; light and dark are co-equal, every token dual-valued.
Hairlines and 2px corners; surfaces are flat — print does not float.
Serif display numerals with tabular figures over a workhorse UI sans; Geist Mono for evidence.
Numbered exhibits and stamp states; sequence carries information.
Status is word + glyph + hue, never colour alone; hue is evidence only.
Ink-filled primary actions; there is no second accent.
One settling curve carries all motion; named moments land once and nothing loops for attention.
A fixed monochrome grain and a 4% ink vignette sit on every page; texture never animates and never carries hue.
Reduced motion is fewer and gentler, not none: travel, scale and layout stop; 140ms opacity and colour answers stay.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary actions are filled with ink itself; there is no second accent. Hue never appears as decoration.

rules.name: The Hue-Is-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Colour survives only where it is evidence — severity, run status, verification, hypotheses — and always arrives with its word and its glyph.

rules.name: The Ink Ladder Rule
rules.body: The six pillars share one ink ladder; sequence and label carry the difference. Never colour the pillars.

rules.name: The Figure Rule
rules.body: Every displayed numeral is set in the serif with tabular figures (.figure); figures are typeset, and units follow in faint sans (/100).

rules.name: The Evidence-Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for evidence only — paths, SHAs, file:line, counts, tool names. Prose and controls stay in the workhorse sans; the serif never carries body text.

rules.name: The One Scroll Rule
rules.body: The content column keeps page scroll; only the rail and the two data regions (the findings table, the agent transcript) scroll inside themselves.

rules.name: The Print-Does-Not-Float Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat; depth is paper tone, hairlines, and a static grain. The login plate is the only shadow at rest, and the row lift is the only shadow that answers a cursor.

rules.name: The Paper-Texture Rule
rules.body: The grain and the vignette are monochrome, fixed, and static — texture, not motion. They are never animated, never tinted, and never brightened into a glow.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px rules and paper tone; corners stop at 2px. Heavier edges are a different surface, not a thicker border.

rules.name: The One-Curve Rule
rules.body: Every transition, entrance and count uses cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). There is no second curve, nothing bounces, and nothing loops for attention.

rules.name: The Fewer-And-Gentler Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion the system drops travel, scale and layout — never feedback: entrances keep their fade, answers cap at 140ms, loops stop, and the sparkline arrives finished.

rules.name: The Lift-Is-Actionable Rule
rules.body: The 1px lift belongs to rows that do something — repositories, analyses, transcript suggestions. Static exhibits, findings rows and plan steps never lift.

dos: Do set every displayed numeral in the serif figure style with tabular figures, and follow it with its unit in faint sans.
Do carry status as word + glyph + hue together; the word is the source of truth.
Do fill primary actions with ink and keep hue out of the action layer.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines and paper-tone recesses; corners stop at 2px.
Do render unmeasured as the hatched track and the em dash — "not measured" is not zero.
Do define every colour token in both themes and route the theme through the .dark class; a stored explicit choice wins over the system preference, which owns first paint.
Do move with the one curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and let values land once; under prefers-reduced-motion travel, scale and layout stop while a 140ms opacity/colour answer stays.
Do lift only rows that act — repositories, analyses, transcript suggestions — and leave static exhibits and findings rows still.
Do keep the grain and vignette fixed, monochrome and static; texture is the world, not an animation.
Do keep the sheen hover-only and monochrome — light across ink, never colour.
donts: Don't add shadows beyond the login plate's soft drop, the stamp's inset seal rule, and the row lift's hover shadow.
Don't use blur, glass, or translucency; paper is opaque.
Don't colour a severity or status without its word and its glyph.
Don't introduce hue as decoration — hue is evidence only.
Don't round past 2px or reach for pill shapes; tickets are print tickets.
Don't put prose in Geist Mono or body text in the serif; each face has one job.
Don't animate or tint the grain and vignette; texture is static paper, not a light effect.
Don't run loops for attention; repeating motion is reserved for live states (in-flight dots, the streaming caret, loading shimmer) and stops under reduced motion.
